Bengaluru Street Vendors Protest Reclamation of Pedestrian Space

Thousands of evicted street vendors gathered at Freedom Park to protest the city corporations' drive to reclaim pedestrian space, demanding rehabilitation for those affected. The move aims to reclaim public spaces and improve urban infrastructure. The vendors' livelihoods were uprooted after the drive began, leaving them without a source of income. The protesters are seeking government intervention to address their concerns.
